hero.lead: Read documents, write files, and run tools. Choose your model, work on your own Mac, and inspect the files and changes along the way.
hero.note: macOS · Apple Silicon · YourBuddy installer pending

example.title: Start with something small.
example.desc: Example task: write a plan in your workspace, then open the file to review it.

items.title: Try asking
items.desc: Create hello-yourbuddy.md in the current directory with three tasks for this week and an acceptance criterion for each. Tell me where you saved it.

items.title: Choose a model and folder
items.desc: Connect an available account or API and select a practice folder.

items.title: Give YourBuddy the task
items.desc: Send your request and respond to any approval prompts in the app.

items.title: Open the file and check it
items.desc: Read the result in the file panel. In a Git repository, you can also review the diff.

items.title: Bring your model
items.desc: Connect an account or provider and switch models for each task. Manage model settings separately from your workspace.

items.title: Keep your files close
items.desc: Work in your own directory, with direct access to files, the editor, terminal, and Git panels.

items.title: Inspect, then improve
items.desc: Review the files and task results first. Use session diagnostics, experiments, and evaluations when you need to compare changes.

cta.title: Open a folder you know.
cta.desc: Choose a model and try a small task. The guide walks you through your first session.

plugins.title: A few useful tools, included.
plugins.desc: These five community plugins come with YourBuddy to help with model access, files, context, and extensions. Each is an independent project, with its source, selection rationale, and prerequisites documented.

items.title: Codex Auth
items.desc: Connect an existing account for models, search, and image capabilities with less repeated setup.

items.title: Better Sidebar
items.desc: Keep files, the editor, terminal, and Git in the sidebar so you can inspect task results.

items.title: Context Doctor
items.desc: Inspect context usage, duplicate content, and shadowed skills to help diagnose session issues.

items.title: Plugin Marketplace
items.desc: Explore available extensions and their sources before adding the tools you need.

items.title: Harbor Evolution
items.desc: Diagnose sessions using task evidence and run controlled experiments and evaluations when needed.
